name: komdosh-dev-spring-platform
description: Audit application/ and domain/ for vendor-coupling leaks (Micrometer, jOOQ, Reactor, Jackson, Spring beyond stereotypes, Kafka client, R2DBC) and stage abstractions into a leaf common/ module. Ships /audit-leaks (audit + extract modes), the platform-developer agent, and rules/platform-module.md (defines the common/ module shape, abstraction patterns for Metrics/Tx/Time/JSON/Outbox/Ids, ArchUnit guards). Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core for foundational rules and the ADR workflow.
